headline: Eriksholm comes to Switch 2 on December 3
title: Eriksholm The Stolen Dream | Switch 2 Dec 3 | Gaming News
video_script: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on December third, twenty twenty six. The stealth strategy game from River End Games and publisher Nordcurrent Labs launches digitally on the Nintendo eShop worldwide. The Switch 2 version supports touchscreen and Joy-Con 2 mouse controls. The game first launched on PC, PS5 and Xbox in July twenty twenty five. Will you sneak in on Switch 2? Comment below!
description: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on December 3, 2026. Sources: Gematsu, Noisy Pixel, Nintendo Everything.
joke: Sneaking is easy, until you step on the one noisy floorboard.
